questions.text: Choose the correct answer of the following (Any seven question only):

subQuestions.text: The principle of virtual work states that the Virtual Work is zero for
options: A body moving with constant linear velocity
A body rotating with constant angular velocity
A body moving with constant linear acceleration

subQuestions.text: What is Kinematics?
options: Branch of dynamics which deals with the study of bodies under motion without considering forces
Branch of dynamics which deals with the study of bodies at rest
Branch of dynamics which deals with the study of bodies under motion by considering forces
Branch of dynamics which deals with the study of bodies under the motion.

options: A force can be replaced by a couple with the same effect
A force can be transmitted through a rigid body without changing its effect
A force can be transmitted through a non-rigid body without changing its effect

subQuestions.text: State and prove the parallelogram law of forces.

A horizontal line $ABCD$ is $10\text{ m}$ long. Forces of $100\text{ N}$, $150\text{ N}$, $200\text{ N}$ and $250\text{ N}$ act at $A$, $B$, $C$ & $D$ respectively with downward direction. The line of these forces makes an angle of $90^\circ, 60^\circ, 45^\circ$ and $30^\circ$ respectively with $AD$. Find the magnitude, direction and position of the resultant force.

(ii) If now the flywheel is brought to rest with a uniform retardation of $0.4\text{ rad/s}^2$, determine the time taken by the flywheel to come to rest.
